notes: Ids are copied from printed swagger path last segments. access_path is swagger origin + printed basePath + path. No radar id was written onto a met, nowcast, oceanforecast, airquality, tidalwater, or datanorge row.
License is the printed swagger CC BY 4.0 URL http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0. Publisher is null: the spec prints contact.name Developer Support, not a publisher.
Original harvested swagger metadata stays in harvested_payloads. Fetch writes observations only. enrichments count stayed 0.

Nowcast stays --source nowcast. Metalerts stays --source met. Airqualityforecast stays --source airquality. Tidalwater stays --source tidalwater. Oceanforecast stays --source oceanforecast. Sunrise stays --source sunrise after PR 103. This source does not re-implement those.
